{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of duplicate patient_id entries
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {df["patient_id"].duplicated().sum()}')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline: {df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999}.sum()')

# Check assay_batch values
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check arm and severity distribution
print(f'Arm distribution:
{df["arm"].value_counts()}
')
print(f'Severity distribution:
{df["severity"].value_counts()}
')

# Check how many patients have multiple sample_seq
sample_seq_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
retested_patients = sample_seq_counts[sample_seq_counts > 1].count()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq (retested): {retested_patients}')"}
